scenarios.preReviewSubject: Duke ’29: Questions About the Morrow & Pike Sophomore Program
scenarios.preReviewBody:
Hi Olivia,

My name is Maya Okafor, and I'm a sophomore at Duke University, your alma mater, graduating in [graduation month] 2029. I'm studying economics and am curious about the sophomore program at Morrow & Pike.

Two questions, if you have a moment. First, when does the sophomore program application open? Second, does the program feed into the summer analyst class?

This past summer I interned at Pinecrest Wealth Partners, where I built a screening model for 40 dividend stocks used in client portfolio reviews. On campus, I'm a consumer sector analyst in the Duke Investment Club. My resume is attached. Thank you very much for your time!

Best,
